sources.home_pose: User selected project HOME [175,0,210,-90,0,0] for the complete-paper view. On 2026-07-31 HOME duration was set to 3000 ms independently of the 6000 ms pick/release duration, and run startup was reordered so HOME is the first NexArm protocol write after opening the serial port.
sources.position_tolerance_mm: User approved 10 mm after repeat stable feedback [168,5,219,-86.7,0,0] produced 8.66 mm position error
sources.paper_to_robot_matrix: Fitted 2026-07-31 from landscape-image corners and user-measured robot XY: image TL/paper(0,0)->(328,139), image TR/paper(0,297)->(331,-130), image BL/paper(210,0)->(139,138), image BR/paper(210,297)->(132,-134). Affine least-squares residual about 2.61 mm RMS.
sources.wrist: User: zero initial roll, clockwise positive, counter-clockwise negative. Software roll range limits were removed by user decision on 2026-07-30.
sources.heights: User set pick_height/release_height to -15 on 2026-07-31 from physical measurement. This does not by itself verify magnetic pickup or final placement accuracy.
sources.transfer: Pick-to-release uses a diagonal arch: 25% XY at Z45, 60% XY at Z75, then diagonal descent to release Z-15. Roll is blended at the same fractions and the three segment durations sum to move_duration_ms=6000.
sources.magnet: STM32 USART1 application uses 115200 8N1 commands and a 50..500 ms timed MAGNET_ON lease. The by-id path ending 5B7A030191 is user-provided deployment data and must be rechecked on Jetson. Production sequence is pick-duration-elapsed -> MAGNET_ON/status-confirm -> release-duration-elapsed -> MAGNET_OFF/status-confirm. physical_pick_verified remains false until post-move visual evidence.
sources.motion: The first controller write after opening and read-only handshake is the direct HOME set_pose command; Q1 does not send CMD_SET_GLOBAL_ACC. Each pose advances after its configured 6000 ms duration because current NexArm coordinate/servo feedback is stale during confirmed physical motion.
sources.target_geometry: The official Figure 2 template remains 100x60 mm. Run 20260731_012300_357937 measured the four fixed source polygons at 6375.18 mm2 versus the nominal 6000 mm2, giving a 1.0308 linear ratio. Q1 uses target_scale=1.03 for this physical four-piece set. The scaled 103x61.8 mm target is centered in the A4 lower/right half with origin [53.5,191.85] mm.

_note: Single active source for NexArm, camera and STM32 magnet endpoints, arm calibration, HOME, motion and planning parameters. Production Q1 is STM32-only; real energization still requires --confirm RUN_Q1. The main sequence uses configured pose durations instead of stale NexArm arrival feedback.
